integration:
PAL-M2-002 — Establish ASGI runtime

authority:
PALAVER_SERVER_MIGRATION_MASTERPLAN_v1.0.0.md — §13.1 (FastAPI), §13.2 (Uvicorn), §19 P2

files:
- ontology/obelisks/_template/segue/gates/_template/segue/innates/_template/segue/exiles/palaver/runtime/asgi.py (new FastAPI app that delegates to existing Palaver bridges and logic)
- ontology/obelisks/_template/segue/gates/_template/segue/innates/_template/segue/exiles/palaver/runtime/server.py (authoritative behavior reference; unchanged)
- pyproject.toml (add FastAPI and Uvicorn dependencies)
- PALAVER_SERVER_MIGRATION_MASTERPLAN_v1.0.0.md (authority; unchanged)

implementation:
- Create palaver/runtime/asgi.py:
  - On import, call bootstrap() to install Envoy, Scrybe, Opus, Coda, and patch-review bridges; reuse bind_host(), canonical_routes(), and helper functions (_workspace_persona_id, _effective_persona_id, etc.) from server.py.
  - Instantiate FastAPI app and define endpoints that mirror canonical behavior:
    - GET /api/routes → return canonical_routes()
    - Persona and voice surfaces: GET /api/personas, GET /api/persona, GET /api/voice/personas, GET /api/voice/persona, GET /api/voice/resolve, POST /api/voice/synthesize (delegate to legacy.* envoy bridge functions and persona precedence logic identical to server.py)
    - Workspace/persona state: GET/POST /api/persona/preference, POST /api/workspace/save (validate persona IDs via _validate_persona_id and persist via workspace_state_save)
    - Chat: POST /api/chat (perform the same contract input/output validation, persona selection precedence, Scrybe context receipt handling, and “response” projection as in server.py; call legacy.chat(message))
    - Patch review lifecycle: POST /api/patch-review/create, /apply, /reject; GET /api/patch-review/pending (delegate to installed patch_review_* bridge functions)
    - Health: GET /api/health (delegate to legacy.health())
  - Expose app = FastAPI(...) and optional __main__ runner that starts Uvicorn with host=bind_host() and port=legacy.PORT or 8787.
- Keep runtime/server.py ThreadingHTTPServer path intact and unmodified during migration; ASGI app reuses the same bridges so behavior remains authoritative and consistent.

compatibility:
- Preserve all existing behaviors and ownership semantics by delegating to the same legacy bridges and helper functions; do not alter validation, persona precedence, Scrybe receipts, or mutation/patch-review ownership.
- Run ASGI (Uvicorn) alongside the existing ThreadingHTTPServer until parity is verified; legacy web UI (/) and any legacy-only paths continue to be served by the current HTTP implementation during migration.
- Default binding honors localhost-only via bind_host(); authority_effect remains none.

dependencies:
- Add to pyproject.toml:
  - fastapi >= 0.110
  - uvicorn[standard] >= 0.30

verification:
- Start ASGI: uvicorn palaver.runtime.asgi:app --host "$(python -c 'import palaver.runtime.server as s; print(s.bind_host())')" --port 8787
- Validate parity with HTTP server using curl:
  - Routes: GET /api/routes returns the same surfaces as canonical_routes()
  - Health: GET /api/health returns ok True (delegated to legacy.health())
  - Chat contract: POST /api/chat with {} yields 400 contract error; valid message returns response plus scrybe context_receipt and trace augmentation
  - Persona precedence: exercise GET /api/persona and POST /api/persona/preference to confirm request > workspace > default selection
  - Voice: GET /api/voice/* resolve endpoints and POST /api/voice/synthesize return expected persona metadata and base64 speech
  - Patch-review: POST /api/patch-review/create/apply/reject and GET /api/patch-review/pending operate via patch-review bridge
- Confirm localhost-only binding by default; leave ThreadingHTTPServer running to serve legacy paths (e.g., /) until ASGI parity is signed off.
